features.name: LapNumber
features.label: Lap number
features.description: Current lap of the race.

features.name: RaceProgress
features.label: Race progress
features.description: How far through the race we are (lap ÷ total laps, 0–1).

features.name: Stint
features.label: Stint number
features.description: Which set of tyres this is (1st stint, 2nd, …). Later stints mean a pit has already happened.

features.name: TyreLife
features.label: Tyre age
features.description: Laps completed on the current set of tyres.

features.name: LapTime_Delta_Clean
features.label: Lap-time delta
features.description: Change in lap time vs the driver's recent clean pace (seconds). Rising = tyres fading.

features.name: laptime_pct_above_median
features.label: % above median pace
features.description: How far this lap is above the field's median lap time (%).

features.name: cumulative_degradation_clean
features.label: Cumulative degradation
features.description: Total lap-time lost this stint to tyre wear (seconds).

features.name: Position
features.label: Track position
features.description: Current running position (P1 = leading).

features.name: position_vs_start
features.label: Positions vs start
features.description: Places gained (+) or lost (−) since the start. Losing places can push a team toward an alternative strategy.

features.name: is_wet_lap
features.label: Wet lap
features.description: Whether the lap is run in wet conditions.

features.name: neutralised_lap
features.label: Safety car / VSC
features.description: Whether a safety car or virtual safety car is active — a cheap moment to pit.

features.name: track_temp_mean
features.label: Track temperature
features.description: Track surface temperature (°C). Hotter tracks degrade tyres faster.

features.name: humidity_mean
features.label: Humidity
features.description: Air humidity (%).

features.name: rainfall_any
features.label: Rainfall
features.description: Any rain falling during the lap.

features.name: wind_speed_mean
features.label: Wind speed
features.description: Wind speed (m/s) — affects car balance and tyre stress.

features.name: circuit_overtaking
features.label: Overtaking ease
features.description: How easy it is to pass here (0 very hard – 2 easy). Hard-to-pass tracks discourage pitting into traffic.

features.name: circuit_is_street
features.label: Street circuit
features.description: Whether this is a street circuit.

features.name: circuit_deg_tier
features.label: Degradation tier
features.description: How tough the circuit is on tyres (0 low – 2 high).

features.name: laptime_trend
features.label: Lap-time trend
features.description: Short-term trend in lap times. A strong upward trend is the clearest 'tyres are done' signal — the model's top feature.

features.name: deg_trend
features.label: Degradation trend
features.description: Whether tyre degradation is accelerating.

features.name: neutralised_prev
features.label: Prev lap neutralised
features.description: Whether the previous lap was under safety car.

features.name: Compound_enc
features.label: Compound
features.description: Tyre compound fitted (soft/medium/hard/intermediate/wet). Softer tyres wear out sooner.

features.name: car_tier_enc
features.label: Car tier
features.description: Car competitiveness (top / midfield / back). Affects strategic stakes.

features.name: circuit_avg_tyre_life
features.label: Avg tyre life
features.description: Typical stint length seen historically at this circuit (laps).

features.name: circuit_pit_rate
features.label: Pit rate
features.description: Historical share of laps that are pit-in laps at this circuit.

features.name: tyre_life_ratio
features.label: Tyre-life ratio
features.description: Tyre age ÷ the compound's typical stint length. Above 1.0 means the tyre is past its normal life.

features.name: laps_past_cliff
features.label: Laps past cliff
features.description: How many laps the tyre is beyond its expected cliff (0 if still fresh enough).

features.name: pit_window_distance
features.label: Pit-window distance
features.description: Distance from the mid-race pit window (|race progress − 0.5|).

features.name: in_pit_window
features.label: In pit window
features.description: Whether we're inside the prime 30–70% race-distance pit window.

features.name: deg_per_lap
features.label: Degradation per lap
features.description: Average tyre time-loss per lap this stint.

features.name: position_pressure
features.label: Position pressure
features.description: 1 ÷ position — higher for the leaders, who have more at stake.

features.name: pos_loss_x_hard_circuit
features.label: Lost places × hard track
features.description: Places lost amplified by how hard the circuit is to overtake.

features.name: track_pos_premium
features.label: Track-position premium
features.description: Value of holding position at a hard-to-pass circuit (reluctance to pit).

features.name: is_soft_medium
features.label: Is soft/medium
features.description: Whether the compound is a soft or medium (faster-wearing).

features.name: tyre_stress
features.label: Tyre stress
features.description: Tyre age weighted by how soft the compound is.

features.name: pit_opportunity
features.label: Pit opportunity
features.description: A discounted-stop opportunity under a safety car / VSC.

features.name: is_stint_start
features.label: Is stint start
features.description: Whether the tyres are very fresh (≤ 2 laps) — won't pit again immediately.

features.name: circuit_deg_x_tyre
features.label: Circuit deg × tyre
features.description: High-degradation circuit combined with old tyres = urgent stop.
